source.title: [find opt-out] Automation Research, Inc.: find the official opt-out route

labels.name: bounty
labels.description: Volunteer task, paid out in karma points

source.body:
**What**: Find Automation Research, Inc.'s official opt-out or "do not sell" route, or show that none exists.

**Why it matters**: Players of Reclaim City use these links to opt out of data brokers, and the dataset is cited by journalists, so a wrong or dead link costs real people real time.

- Broker: Automation Research, Inc. (`automation-research`)
- Website: not recorded
- Listed in the registries: VT
- Current opt-out in the dataset: none (`optOut` is null, which means unknown, not that the broker offers none)
- Vermont's registry gives opt-out instructions as free text. Read this broker's Vermont entry first, as a starting point: https://bizfilings.vermont.gov/databrokersearch/Search

**What to do**
1. Read the broker's Vermont entry (https://bizfilings.vermont.gov/databrokersearch/Search) for its opt-out instructions, then confirm them on the broker's own site and privacy policy.
2. Check its entry in the other registries it appears in (the snapshots are in [`sources/registries/`](https://github.com/lizTheDeveloper/privacy-the-game/blob/main/research/data-brokers/sources/registries/)).
3. Report the URL (or email or address), plus the method: web form, email, mail or portal.
4. If you find no route after checking all of these, report that with evidence of where you looked.
5. Capture each page you used. The Vermont search uses a CAPTCHA: a capture of it may not work, so describe the entry in your comment instead.

**What counts as done**
Comment on this issue with the route, its method, where you found it, and a Wayback capture (https://web.archive.org/save/<url>) of every page you used. Paste the capture links.

Code-literate volunteers may open a PR instead. Opt-out URLs come from the state registries and our research pass, not from a hand-edited file, and generated files (`brokers/`, `links.json`, `sources.json`, `src/data/broker-map.json`) must never be edited by hand; see "How to rebuild" in the [README](https://github.com/lizTheDeveloper/privacy-the-game/blob/main/research/data-brokers/README.md). If no file under `research/data-brokers/build/` fits your fix, a comment is the right route.

**Ground rules**
- No fake accounts.
- Never submit someone else's personal information.
- Don't share your own personal data in the issue. Redact it from screenshots and captures.
- If a form demands an ID upload or payment, stop and report that here instead.

---
Bounty: paid in karma points. Comment to claim it before you start, so two people don't do the same one.
